title: Understanding and Mitigating Cross-Session Attacks via Persistent Artifacts in Agent Skill Composition
abstract: arXiv:2610.13227v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent skills extend the capabilities of AI agents by bundling instructions, code, and resources into reusable packages. During skill execution, agents may produce or modify artifacts, such as files, configurations, and cached data, that are reused by other skills in later sessions. Since these artifacts can persist across sessions and later be accessed by other skills, they introduce a new attack surface that can be exploited to influence subsequent executions. However, the security risks arising from such cross-session skill interactions remain largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate cross-session composition attacks in skill-based AI agents and develop a runtime defense against them. Specifically, we characterize three attack mechanisms, namely Instruction Propagation (IP), Data Boundary Violation (DBV), and Evidence Poisoning (EP), through which malicious effects propagate across skill executions via persistent artifacts. T

translated_title: 理解并缓解智能体技能组合中经由持久化工件发起的跨会话攻击
translated_abstract: 智能体技能通过将指令、代码和资源打包成可复用的软件包来扩展AI智能体的能力。在技能执行过程中，智能体可能会生成或修改工件，例如文件、配置和缓存数据，这些工件会在后续会话中被其他技能复用。由于这些工件能够跨会话持久存在并被其他技能后续访问，它们引入了一个新的攻击面，可被利用来影响后续执行。然而，这种跨会话技能交互所产生的安全风险在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本工作中，我们研究了基于技能的AI智能体中的跨会话组合攻击，并开发了一种针对这些攻击的运行时防御方法。具体而言，我们刻画了三种攻击机制，即指令传播（Instruction Propagation, IP）、数据边界违反（Data Boundary Violation, DBV）和证据投毒（Evidence Poisoning, EP），恶意影响正是通过这些机制经由持久化工件在技能执行之间进行传播。
tldr: 本文首次系统刻画了AI智能体技能组合中经由持久化工件传播恶意影响的三种跨会话攻击机制（指令传播、数据边界违反、证据投毒），并据此提出了相应的运行时防御方法。
